name: dither-ts
description: Open source dithering experiment in TypeScript

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.coverage:all: npm run coverage:node && npm run coverage:app
scripts.coverage:node: npm run build && c8 --all --include="dist/src/**/*.js" --exclude="dist/test/**" --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --check-coverage --lines=20 --functions=20 --branches=10 --statements=20 node --test dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.desktop: npm --prefix app run build && npm --prefix electron run dev
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm --prefix app test && npm --prefix electron test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run coverage:all && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build:all
